title: Stainless Steel Kettle, Whistling, Heat Proof Handle, 2.75 Quart, Red,  by QuCrow
text: Stainless Steel Kettle, Whistling, Heat Proof Handle, 2.75 Quart, Red,  by QuCrow. Disappointed because it looks GREAT. I love the color and the deign looks fabulous. First problem is the lid. it is really tough to take off and to pull back on, the top is not a good fit to the extent that if you have arthritis in your hands I would give this a pass, I don't have that health issue and I find the lid not user friendly at all, basically the lid is too big and doesn't fit unless you force it on.  The second thing is the poor spout, it leaked down the side and on to the counter as I poured it into my mug.

product_metadata.title: QuCrow Whistling Tea Kettle with Heat-Proof Handle, Kitchen Grade Stainless Steel Teapot Stovetops, 3 Quart, Silver
features: Durable and Surgical Whistling Teapot with Kitchen Grade Stainless Steel, it is strongly rust-resistant and corrosion-resistant. Also,100% Teflon-Free, BPA-Free.

Enhanced Heating Performance With 5-PLY Encapsulated Base, with an Iron layer between 2 Aluminum layers wrapped inside of 18/8 stainless steel, teapot for stovetop is built for quick heating and compatibility with all stovetops including INDUCTION.

Heat Proof & Foldable Handle and Removable Lid. Heat resisting handle for safety, and removable lid make filling and cleaning easier. Caution! KEEP THE HANDLE STANDING UP DURING BOILING. Oven mitt is recommended while heating on gas stove.

Fast Boiling with Large Capacity, 3 Quart Teapot is Built for Saving Time and Energy. Quicker boiling times come standard on tea kettle, thanks to its 9-inch-wide base and aluminum & iron-layered bottom even large capacity can be boiled in minutes.

All Stovetops Whistling Tea Kettle Including INDUCTION. With single-tone whistles to remind you the boiled kettle while you were not in kitchen room. The Thumb-Press Spout makes pouring easy - simply tip, open, and pour in a single motion.
